title: Capybara's Cosmic Codex
description: A surreal scene depicts a large brown capybara floating above cracked desert ground, adorned with flowers, a golden eye, and a cracked egg on its back from which golden liquid drips. In the foreground, a human hand reaches toward an open ancient book emitting swirling colorful smoke while two smaller eggs and strange rock formations appear in the barren landscape under a purple sky.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape at dusk with purple sky and swirling colorful smoke, a giant brown capybara with a glowing golden eye floats in the center adorned with colorful flowers and a cracked egg on its back leaking golden liquid, small eggs and rock formations in background, in the foreground a human hand reaching toward an open ancient grimoire with glowing pages and symbols, highly detailed symbolic painting in the style of Dali and Giger
